literal: Having seen the appearance, not despising is necessary; for the rolling big chariot, those who are like the axle-pin, it has.
translation: One should not despise others by looking at their appearance; for even a mighty rolling chariot has those who are like its small axle-pin.
modern: ஒருவருடைய தோற்றத்தைக் கண்டு அவரை இகழக் கூடாது; உருண்டோடும் பெரிய தேருக்கு அச்சாணி போன்றவர்கள் இவ்வுலகில் இருக்கிறார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet advises us never to underestimate or mock anyone based solely on their physical size or outward appearance. To illustrate this, it uses the metaphor of a massive, rolling chariot. Though the chariot is grand and powerful, it cannot move or function without its tiny axle-pin. Similarly, there are individuals who may seem small or insignificant in appearance, but they possess the essential strength and capability to hold great tasks together.
